newsitem.title: UK: Tomkins gains after trading statement.
newsitem.headline: Tomkins gains after trading statement.

text.p: Shares in diverisified manufacturer Tomkins Plc rose on Friday after an upbeat trading statement at the company's annual general meeting, dealers said.

The stock was up 10-1/2p at 273 by 1352 GMT on more than 2.3 million shares traded, also pulled higher by a strong performance in the UK stock market overall as the FTSE 100 index reached record levels.
The Tomkins gain was "nothing spectacular," said one dealer. "It's just pushing ahead with the good statement and the rest of the market."
Another said, "There have been two or three buyers first thing and the market's strong. If there's a bull story to be talked about this afternoon, it will be listened to."
Tomkins chairman Greg Hutchings said the company was benefiting from a "generally favourable trading environment with orderbooks, in aggregate, ahead of the same period last year."
